coverage.plan_output_note: goals.decompose is structural plan-output validation; it does not prove a persisted execution or mutation.

gaps: Declared mutations without an independent verifier are never certified applied: the shared adapter downgrades an already dispatched effect to uncertain and preserves its identity.
The uncovered names above remain explicit; add a verifier or keep them out of mutating assignment dispatch.
HTTP mutation routes remain outside the registered action registry; this slice does not qualify them.
next_verifiers: Add independent readback verifiers for the remaining local mini-app mutations or keep them out of mutating assignment dispatch.
Provider mutations (Shopify) need authoritative readback before they can be applied through the assignment path.
Plan-output validation remains structural; add persistence postconditions only where an action actually persists state.
